summary: Train student 3a: tiny cross-encoder distilled on teacher logits, training card in runs/edges/scorer/
description: MiniLM-class (<=25M) cross-encoder, MSE/margin distillation on teacher logits over pairs.jsonl; optional light fine-tune on gold-cal. 3090 with per-run owner permission. Deliverables: checkpoint, training card (data hash, config, curves), and teacher-agreement number vs spec target. If the first student misses spec, try the second candidate architecture before touching the data.

resolution.note: Student 3a trained on 3090: 22.7M params, 4 epochs, val Pearson +0.8722 vs teacher on held-out queries (spec bar 0.85). Training card in runs/edges/scorer/2026-08-13-run1/student-3a/.
